positive_snippets: I have stayed in this hotel with family for 2 days and i was really impressed with the quality of food and especially the service of Mr. Anoop and Mr. Jitu.

Nice hotel with good services in a poor locality. You get it at a discounted rate for the locality which makes it a good offer. The services are top class, the room is spacious while the bathroom is good. Despite saying that, my bathroom did have leakage issues which was not rectified during my 3 days stay.

Great value for money for the price offered. Breakfast was great, mix of continental and Chinese. Nothing more for 2000 rs price I paid through Agoda. Areas of improvement
1. The staff at the reception have no authority . They simply follow what they have been told
2. They were still quoting 4000 rs for the same room available at half the price.
3. There is no one to park your car...You have to do it yourself
4. People will rather go to country inn with swimming pool and more at 4000 rs
5. Simply things like a cellphone charger are not available.
negative_snippets: This hotel is a new property. Rooms are nice and clean. But the buffet dinner and breakfast is the worst. Buffet does not have varieties at all. Only two to three dishes only. No starters. For buffet breakfast they don't even serve omlette!!. When I requested for an omlette, they just refused. They call it as a four star hotel, but facilities are not there for even a 3 star catogery. Overall it had good rooms but pathetic buffet dinner and breakfast

Pathetic place to stay. The staff is so rude and non cooperative. The food quality is ridiculous. We had dinner included in our package but the waiter came up with 2-3 items to choose from that too just verbally like in a dhaba. The 4 star rating is absurd. Our food came very late by that time we weren't even hungry so requested the food to be sent up to our room. The waiter rudely refused. Well if you call..yourself a high standard hotel, a bit of courtesy should be there for your guests. Our next table guest also faced the same issues. It was a ruckus in the dining area. Most pathetic  experience. Will never ever recommend this property.
